selected_by_owner: Strict successor of completed MTLC-03; selection grants no implementation authority.

dependencies.parallel_lane_rule: GPR and CWKS remain independent. MTLC may consume their current contracts as explicit dependencies without mutating their lane scope.

scope.name: Scheduling, Attendance, and Real-World Logistics
scope.responsibility: Remove the administrative work of finding a date, confirming attendance, handling timezones and recurring sessions, rescheduling, reminding players, coordinating bounded venue/session logistics, and deciding how a campaign proceeds when attendance is incomplete.
exit_criteria: Groups can poll availability and maintain recurring schedules.
RSVP, late, absent, cancellation, reschedule, reminder, and timezone flows are complete.
Campaigns can define bounded run-anyway policies such as minimum quorum, approved absent-character proxy behavior, or alternate async/one-shot fallback.
Calendar handoff/export and real-world logistics do not require duplicate manual entry.

next_action: Await the owner's MTLC-04 execution instruction before implementation.
